answer: Submitting an answer locks 23 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The nadir escrow is released only against a fable receipt, and the zenith audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 117 aliases means carrying 40 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
